verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, so Git submodule management is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions git, cloning, or submodules. The listed commands (ios_system tools, pkg-installed WebAssembly commands, Python, Lua, clang) never include git, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can clone, update, and manage Git submodules within a repository
